One yaz job serves every target of served.json in turn (loop.job run: today two, the toy and the copy), and each target's cycle signs its own root. Read per job, two targets leave one spare call for both roots, and four or more targets could not all be signed in one job even when every call succeeds. Read per root, a job of two targets may run the program up to 6 times. The code is per root (loop.sign RUNS = 3 for each sign of one root; a signer is made per target), and has been since seed-068; this is stated in loop/sign.py and the per-target sign_calls list makes the count of each root visible in the job's line. The signer also runs the same program's 'verify identity' once on the bundle of the run that signed (loop.sign step 3). Chosen: a call is a run of 'sign' (the runs that can write to Rekor); the verify run is not an entry, and its refusal is named as the result of the sign run whose bundle it refused.
